name: Ivan Gnizditskiy
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: An unbeaten Russian light heavyweight (7-0, age 30) who signed directly with the UFC after visa problems kept him off his Contender Series bout. He has finished all seven wins, six by knockout, and fought twice in ONE in 2025. Our data has only one of his fights.

how_they_fight.Striking: A finisher: six knockouts in seven wins (Sherdog).

concerns: UFC debut; very little film or data
